out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at BAR handwashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC ADDED SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE THE BAR HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED WITH SOAP/TOWELS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION. PIC IS IN PROCESS OF RECEIVING CERTIFICATION (ALONG IWTH ANOTHER STAFF MEMBER) BUT HAS NOT TAKEN THE EXAM YET.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE SEND THE EHS THE CERTIFICATION FOR CFMs ONCE THEY HAVE TAKEN THE EXAM. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: WATER FROM THE THREE-VAT SINK LEAKS ONTO FLOOR SLIGHTLY BEFORE ENTERING FLOOR DRAIN FROM THE SANITIZER BASIN (DUE TO GRATE ON FLOOR DRAIN).
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE REPAIR THE PLUMBING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.
